title: What's in your bag?
objectives: describe items inside bags or containers using there is / there are

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Greet student and introduce lesson objectives for What's in your bag?.
Welcome to today's lesson: What's in your bag?! Today we will practice how to describe items inside bags or containers using there is / there are.

elements.content: Lesson Objectives for What's in your bag?:
describe items inside bags or containers using there is / there are; distinguish singular and plural items

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Introduce target vocabulary and key language structures using concept check questions.

elements.content: Review key terms and target language below:
Key terms: bag, phone, keys, lamp, mirror, room

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Check understanding through controlled choice exercise.

elements.content: Complete: 'There ___ three keys on the table.'

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Develop reading comprehension and listening skills.

teacherNotes.title: Listening Tapescript
teacherNotes.content: In my bag, there is a mirror and there are three keys. What is in your bag?

elements.content: Read the short passage below (recycling introduced vocabulary):
There is a phone in my bag. There are keys on the table. In my room, there is a big lamp.
Listening Task: Listen to your teacher / audio prompt and answer the comprehension question.

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Provide communicative speaking practice and personalized interaction.

elements.content: Describe five objects currently inside your bag or on your desk using there is/are.

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Review key corrections and confirm homework task.
Great work today! Remember to review target words in your mobile app before our next class.

elements.content: Today you practiced: describe items inside bags or containers using there is / there are, distinguish singular and plural items.
